title: sp architects adapts antalya expo grounds for COP31
summary:
SP ARCHITECTS REWORKS EXPO 2016 FOR COP31 IN ANTALYAAntalya’s former EXPO 2016 site has taken on a second assignment.
As COP31 runs in the Turkish city from November 9 to 20, SP Architects has transformed the 875,117-square-meter horticultural exhibition grounds in Aksu into a conference campus for diplomats, scientists, civil society and visitors.
the former Expo grounds have been transformedMODULAR STRUCTURES GIVE COP31 A LIFE BEYOND THE SUMMITThroughout the complex, SP Architects has sought to balance the demanding requirements of an international diplomatic event with a more adaptable architectural framework.
New permanent and temporary structures are integrated into the existing grounds, with modular and reusable components intended to limit unnecessary construction.
For SP Architects, the redevelopment represents an investment in the city’s future rather than a temporary backdrop for international diplomacy.

What Is A Dirty Bomb?
A dirty bomb is a conventional explosive device combined with radioactive material.
It differs from a nuclear bomb because a regular explosive is used rather than creating a nuclear chain reaction.
A dirty bomb could impact several city blocks, whereas a nuclear blast would vaporize much of a city.

title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
summary:
Iran launched a drone attack against a US military base in Bahrain on Sunday, its second attempt to target the country in three days.
The country's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it targeted the US air defence radar facility at al-Riffa air base in Bahrain using six drones.
Bahrain's military said its air defence systems intercepted and destroyed the Iranian air attacks "before they could achieve their objectives".
It comes after Iran fired drones at Bahrain on Friday, its first attack against Gulf countries since September.
The US military has denied the claim, stating that the IRGC launched two one-way attack drones towards Bahrain and both were shot down by US forces.
